name: eizport
description: Move WordPress content with its media, settings and files: .wxrz bundles for the WordPress Importer, Playground zips, and abilities for AI agents.

paragraphs: Contributors: eizport, camaleaun Donate link: Tags: export, import, wxr, migration, media Requires at least: 7.0 Tested up to: 7.1 Requires PHP: 7.4 Stable tag: 0.10.0 License: GPLv2 or later License URI:
Export content with its media files in one .wxrz bundle and import it with the WordPress Importer, without downloading the media again.

Exporter Importer Z gives Tools → Export a new screen, built like WordPress's newest admin screens, and extends the WordPress Importer. The classic Export screen, with the same choices added, stays one setting away.
features: One list: the content types, Attachments and Options. Check what to export; nothing checked exports all content.
Items in a side panel: each type's items with search, filters and a checkbox per item — by filters or by selection. Items show their roles (Homepage, Posts page, Shop page…).

Options: one by one, by group (Basics suggested) or all of them. Settings that point to the items exported (homepage, posts page, privacy policy page, site icon, WooCommerce pages) come along, as Settings says.
The file in a footer: format (WXR XML, or WXRZ once media files or settings go with it, or a Playground .zip), file name, media files, Playground themes and plugins.
Save as default: start with the same choices next time (yours, or the site's).
